Challenged 59 prior generic NA cells against a 193-Rust/61-renderer/14-Swift-helper census; direct declarations without invoked APIs remain NA. Checked all 15 Swift owners against headless media-worker and verifier sources: AVFoundation/Vision/Speech framework use alone is not owner-contract overlap; verifier timed-word output differs from RightKitSpeech String transcription. Corrected cargo/npm rightkit-shell NA→N: CutRight directly calls same caption-window actions as shared shell commands without a shared route. Challenged compose decoder vs evaluated model, project JSON vs six shared contracts, timestamped phrase search vs SQL/FTS/snippets, webview shortcuts vs native hotkeys, DOM menu dismissal vs native overlay, legal document viewer vs LegalGate, renderer logs vs native stderr, transitive platform-ui, & review evaluator vs app-specific QA. Y rows cite owner API definitions plus production invocation; N rows cite active local implementation plus exact migration task.
